hero.tagline: I build things — from terminal games to crypto bots. Here's a look at the projects I'm working on.

about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a Software Engineering student at the University of Minho who likes building things end to end — most of them start in a terminal. I've written dungeon crawlers and a solitaire engine in C and Python, a crypto arbitrage bot at a hackathon, and a full reselling web app. I care about clean code, shipping tools people actually use, and learning whatever the next project needs.

dungeon-crawler.title: Dungeon Crawler
dungeon-crawler.short: A terminal dungeon crawler — fight monsters, level up and beat the final boss.
dungeon-crawler.long: A role-playing game played entirely in the terminal. Explore a dungeon, fight monsters, gain XP and level up, collect loot, and take down the final boss — all through a command-line interface.

crypto-arbitrage-bot.title: Bot.byte — Crypto Arbitrage Bot
crypto-arbitrage-bot.short: A crypto arbitrage bot built at the BugsByte 26 hackathon (UMinho).
crypto-arbitrage-bot.long: Built at the BugsByte 26 hackathon at the University of Minho with team Chill. Bot.byte analyses and compares crypto prices across exchanges in real time and simulates simultaneous buy and sell orders to capture the spread of a pair between different exchanges. Dashboard built with Streamlit.

solitaire-cli.title: LI2 Card Games
solitaire-cli.short: Four solitaires (Golf, Simple Simon, Klondike, FreeCell) in one C engine.
solitaire-cli.long: A suite of terminal card games written in C for the Software Laboratory II (LI2) course at the University of Minho. A single data-driven engine reads each solitaire from text files written in a small DSL and plays Golf, Simple Simon, Klondike and FreeCell — with move validation, automatic moves, win detection, undo and save/load. Built under strict constraints (no global variables, low cyclomatic complexity) and covered by CUnit tests.

background-remover.title: Batch Background Remover
background-remover.short: A Python script that batch-removes backgrounds from thousands of product photos.
background-remover.long: A Python script that batch-removes backgrounds from a large image catalogue — around 10,000 football-jersey photos (23 GB) — producing transparent PNGs ready for e-commerce. Built for the Infinity Imports PT catalogue: it loads the u2net AI model once, mirrors the source folder tree, and is resume-safe (it skips files already done, so you can stop and restart with Ctrl+C). Corrupted files are logged and skipped instead of crashing the run, a live progress bar shows speed and ETA, and memory is kept stable over long runs with periodic garbage collection. Runs natively on Apple Silicon through ONNX Runtime.

resell-tracker.title: ReSell — Reselling Tracker
resell-tracker.short: A web app to run a reselling business: costs, margins, profit and partner splits.
resell-tracker.long: A web app to run a reselling operation end to end. It organizes everything by order and item and works out what matters — real cost (piece + PayPal fee + shipping), margin, profit and days to sell — plus a global summary, profit per category and per partner, and monthly reports. It also includes an order builder that generates a catalog image and a ready-to-send WhatsApp message, pre-orders, an encrypted accounts vault, automatic backups, and a trilingual (PT/EN/ES) installable PWA. Built with Next.js and SQLite (node:sqlite) — no UI or charting libraries, just hand-written CSS and CSS-bar charts.
